# Medusa Store

> A global e-commerce store built on Medusa and Next.js. This file helps AI
> assistants and answer engines understand the site's structure and find the
> most useful pages. Replace this description with your brand, value
> proposition and primary product categories before launch.

## Key pages

- [Store / All products](/dk/store): Browse the full product catalog.
- [Cart](/dk/cart): Current shopping cart.
- [Account](/dk/account): Customer account and order history.

## Products

Each product has a detail page at `/{country}/products/{handle}` with
schema.org Product + Offer JSON-LD (name, description, images, price,
currency and availability) rendered server-side for accurate AI citation.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices and availability are authoritative in the per-product JSON-LD.
- The store is multi-region; `{country}` in the URL (e.g. `dk`) selects the
  region and currency.
- For programmatic access, a public Store API is available via the Medusa
  backend; contact the store operator for API credentials.
